caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a woven straw or rush seat. The chair features turned legs and spindles, with three horizontal, wavy slats forming the backrest. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with subtle variations indicating light and shadow, as well as the wood grain. The seat is light tan with distinct texture lines representing the woven material. The chair is centered and set against a plain, off-white background. Near the bottom of the image, the artist's name "RUTH BIALOSTOSKY" is written in all capital letters.
title: Side Chair
